# Zarman Exchange

> Zarman Exchange (Zarman Exchange Pty Ltd, ABN: 70 692 742 957) is an AUSTRAC-registered online remittance and currency exchange platform specialising in AUD to IRT (Iranian Toman) transfers for the Australian-Iranian community.

## About

Zarman Exchange provides secure, fast, and competitively priced international money transfer services from Australia to Iran. The platform offers dynamic, volume-based exchange rates and enterprise-grade compliance under Australian financial regulations.

- Registered with AUSTRAC as a Remittance Dealer
- ABN: 70 692 742 957
- Serving the Australian-Iranian community
- Specialises in AUD ↔ IRT (Australian Dollar to Iranian Toman) exchange
- Website available in English (en-AU) and Persian (fa-IR)

## Services

- AUD to IRT international money transfer
- Real-time currency exchange rates (AUD/IRT)
- Volume-based personalised exchange rates
- Secure online remittance platform
